payload.reason: The evidence indicates that the proposed NER model utilizes language-independent features derived from cross-lingual wikification, which allows it to recognize named entities not explicitly listed on Wikipedia by grounding them in categories and types from Wikipedia entries.

claims.text: The proposed NER model can account for named entities not listed on Wikipedia by using language-independent features derived from cross-lingual wikification.
The model grounds words and phrases in non-English text into English Wikipedia entries, enabling recognition of entities across different languages.
Wikifier features provide significant improvements in named entity recognition, suggesting that they can help identify entities not found in Wikipedia.
